CveFindings.Name: Improper Handling of Exceptional Conditions in Newtonsoft.Json
CveFindings.Description:
[CVE-2024-21907](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-5crp-9r3c-p9vr): Newtonsoft.Json versions before 13.0.1 can process deeply nested JSON in a way that causes excessive resource consumption or stack overflow, resulting in denial of service.

Severity: HIGH

Affected dependencies:
  - Newtonsoft.Json 10.0.3 (NYCJobsWeb/packages.config:17)
  - Newtonsoft.Json 9.0.1 (DataLoader/DataLoader/packages.config:3)

Recommended fix: Upgrade both package references to 13.0.1 or later, or configure an appropriate maximum JSON depth.

CveFindings.Name: .NET Core Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
CveFindings.Description:
[CVE-2021-26701](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-ghhp-997w-qr28): System.Text.Encodings.Web versions 4.6.0 through 4.7.1 are affected by a remote code execution vulnerability related to text encoding.

Severity: CRITICAL

Affected dependency:
  - System.Text.Encodings.Web 4.6.0 (NYCJobsWeb/packages.config:23)

Recommended fix: Upgrade to 4.7.2 or later (or the patched version appropriate for the target framework).

CweFindings.Name: Loop with Unreachable Exit Condition ('Infinite Loop')
CweFindings.Description: The product contains an iteration or loop with an exit condition that cannot be reached, i.e., an infinite loop.
CweFindings.Explanation: In UpdateMap, the while loop at line 193 repeats while map.entities.getLength() is greater than zero. The only attempted exit is map.entities.clear() inside a try; if clear throws, the empty catch at lines 195-198 suppresses the exception and the loop condition remains true, so the browser thread can hang.

CweFindings.Name: Use of Hard-coded Credentials
CweFindings.Description: The product contains hard-coded credentials, such as a password or cryptographic key.
CweFindings.Explanation: The page embeds a non-empty mapping-service API credential directly in the client-side map initialization at line 114. It is shipped to every browser as application source. The credential value is intentionally omitted from this report.

CweFindings.Name: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')
CweFindings.Description: The product does not neutralize or incorrectly neutralizes user-controllable input before it is placed in output that is used as a web page that is served to other users.
CweFindings.Explanation: UpdateBusinessTitleFacets and UpdatePostingTypeFacets concatenate Azure Search facet values directly into HTML and pass the result to jQuery .html() (lines 313-335). UpdateJobDetails also inserts indexed business_title and work_location values into HTML at lines 397-398 without output encoding, allowing stored script markup from indexed content to execute in visitors’ browsers.
